guard: space create prepares a space only for a free name and a free root that is not the home folder, makes its .cotal, and every reader lists, shows, selects or refuses it as prepared; up starts it only in its root and drops the prepared record; forget removes it
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/space-registration.smoke.ts
why: Each mutation removes one check space create makes before it writes, one place a reader recognises a prepared space, or one step up takes when it starts one. The suite drives the built binary, so each mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.

mutations.name: create does not refuse a registered name
mutations.expectRed: a registered name is CONFLICT
mutations.cell: a registered name is CONFLICT

mutations.name: create does not refuse a prepared name
mutations.expectRed: a prepared name is CONFLICT, exit 2, naming its root
mutations.cell: a prepared name is CONFLICT, exit 2, naming its root

mutations.name: create does not read the root's space accounts
mutations.expectRed: a folder whose .cotal holds another space's account is CONFLICT
mutations.cell: a folder whose .cotal holds another space's account is CONFLICT

mutations.name: create does not read the registrations rooted there
mutations.expectRed: a folder a registration names as its root is CONFLICT
mutations.cell: a folder a registration names as its root is CONFLICT

mutations.name: create does not read the space prepared there
mutations.expectRed: a folder already prepared for a space is CONFLICT
mutations.cell: a folder already prepared for a space is CONFLICT

mutations.name: create accepts the home folder
mutations.expectRed: the home folder is CONFLICT
mutations.cell: the home folder is CONFLICT

mutations.name: create accepts a --root that is not a directory
mutations.expectRed: a --root that is not a directory is USAGE_INVALID
mutations.cell: a --root that is not a directory is USAGE_INVALID

mutations.name: create does not make the root's .cotal
mutations.expectRed: create prepares the space in this folder and makes its .cotal: ok, nothing registered
mutations.cell: create prepares the space in this folder and makes its .cotal: ok, nothing registered

mutations.name: add does not refuse a prepared name
mutations.expectRed: adding a prepared name is CONFLICT, naming cotal up
mutations.cell: adding a prepared name is CONFLICT, naming cotal up

mutations.name: forget leaves a prepared space recorded
mutations.expectRed: a prepared space is forgotten; the .cotal create made stays
mutations.cell: a prepared space is forgotten; the .cotal create made stays

mutations.name: create takes every add flag
mutations.expectRed: an add flag other than --root on create is USAGE_INVALID
mutations.cell: an add flag other than --root on create is USAGE_INVALID

mutations.name: space lists no prepared spaces
mutations.expectRed: space lists it apart from the registrations
mutations.cell: space lists it apart from the registrations

mutations.name: space show does not find a prepared space
mutations.replace: const p = undefined as PreparedSpace | undefined;
mutations.expectRed: space show shows it as prepared
mutations.cell: space show shows it as prepared

mutations.name: a selected prepared space is warned about as missing
mutations.expectRed: a selected prepared space is not warned about as missing
mutations.cell: a selected prepared space is not warned about as missing

mutations.name: use does not find a prepared space
mutations.replace: const p = undefined as ReturnType<typeof findPreparedSpace>;
mutations.expectRed: use selects it and names its root
mutations.cell: use selects it and names its root

mutations.name: status calls a prepared selection not recorded
mutations.expectRed: status says the selected space is prepared, not started
mutations.cell: status says the selected space is prepared, not started

mutations.name: --space does not refuse a prepared space
mutations.expectRed: a command naming it with --space is TARGET_UNAVAILABLE, naming its root
mutations.cell: a command naming it with --space is TARGET_UNAVAILABLE, naming its root

mutations.name: the selection does not refuse a prepared space
mutations.expectRed: a command that targets it is TARGET_UNAVAILABLE, naming cotal up in its root
mutations.cell: a command that targets it is TARGET_UNAVAILABLE, naming cotal up in its root

mutations.name: the local root does not refuse a prepared space

mutations.cell: a command run in its root with nothing selected is TARGET_UNAVAILABLE

mutations.name: not-started is not a target-unavailable code
mutations.expectRed: a command that targets it is TARGET_UNAVAILABLE, naming cotal up in its root
mutations.cell: a command that targets it is TARGET_UNAVAILABLE, naming cotal up in its root

mutations.name: up in a prepared root starts the default space
mutations.expectRed: up in its root starts it under its name, and the prepared record goes
mutations.cell: up in its root starts it under its name, and the prepared record goes

mutations.cell: up --space for it from another folder refuses, naming its root, and makes nothing there

mutations.name: up runs another space in a prepared root

mutations.cell: up --space for another space in its root refuses

mutations.name: up keeps the prepared record of a space it started
